# AgentRouter

Use `agentrouter/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "agentrouter-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "agentrouter/claude-opus-4-8",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://agentrouter.org/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL`.

- https://agentrouter.org/docs/opencode.html
